d:
The Timberwolves defeated the Pelicans, 115-109 tonight in New Orleans. Ayo Dosunmu finished with a team-high 26 points along with 4 assists and 4 three pointers for the Timberwolves, while Jaden McDaniels tallied 23 points, 6 rebounds and 5 assists in the game. Jeremiah Fears recorded 24 points, 5 rebounds and 5 assists. The Timberwolves improve their record to 7-3 with the win, while the Pelicans fall to 4-5 for the season.
